title: Pet profile labels
summary: Pet sex and neutering status now read as Title Case labels on pet profile screens.
changes: Pet lists and profile summaries show sex and neutering status such as Male and Not Neutered instead of stored values.
Pet create and edit selects show Title Case labels while keeping the same stored values.
version_rationale: Patch on the 0.43 line: display labels only, with no data, validation or permission change.
validation: PetProfileWorkflowLabelsTest covers the list, summary line and selects.
composer pre-merge on the pull request branch.
known_limitations: Species stays free text as entered.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release package. No database change is involved.
